source_type_X.observed_description: Typed source operand X of the context-bound otimes composition.
source_type_X.source_role: Left or first source operand participating in binary partial composition.

source_type_Z.observed_description: Typed source operand Z of the context-bound otimes composition.
source_type_Z.source_role: Right or second source operand participating in binary partial composition.

source_context_type_Y.observed_description: Context Y under which X otimes_Y Z is evaluated.
source_context_type_Y.source_role: Supplies context-bound typing and admissibility conditions.

target_orientation_type.observed_description: The element type of Omega_obs, the possible observation-orientation family.
target_orientation_type.scope: Relative to >S< and D_rel before RefOrient_x.
target_orientation_type.target_role: Ordered observation-orientation candidate o_i or o_j.

shared_structure.identified_surface: A pre-RefOrient, context-bound relational evaluation of two source operands and an ordered observation-orientation candidate pair.
what_is_shared: Potential distinction evaluation over a pair.
what_is_not_established: X or Z is an Omega_obs element.
X or Z has a governed carrier representation of o_i or o_j.
D(X|Z) and d_obs(o_i,o_j) share an ordered codomain or scale.
Y maps to B_x, D_rel, and R.
The source relation preserves threshold failure semantics.

type_mismatches: Source operands are described as RT/aRT typed operands or transformations, not as Omega_obs elements.
Source context Y has no declared component mapping into B_x, D_rel, and R.
No governed source-to-observation carrier type bridge exists.
No source/observation distinction-scale relation is established.

phase_gate.next_phase_condition: Only formulate falsifiable relation hypotheses; do not instantiate rules or witnesses.
